book_name: 李慧芳老师近一年P4答案词

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: He adds antifreeze to the car in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天给汽车加防冻液。
words.en: A substance added to a liquid to lower its freezing point, used especially in the radiator of a motor vehicle.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.ex: Birds begin migration in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在秋天开始迁徙。
words.en: The movement of people, animals, or birds from one place to another, especially regularly according to the seasons.

words.tr: n. 月（month 的复数形式）
words.ex: He waited for months to get his visa.
words.ex_cn: 他等了好几个月才拿到签证。
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.ex: The children play under the trees.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树下玩耍。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant that has a wooden trunk and branches that grow from its upper part.

words.ex: The rivers flow into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入大海。
words.en: Rivers are large natural streams of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.tr: n. 旅游者；观光者；“tourist”的复数；
words.ex: Many tourists visit the Great Wall every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年有许多旅游者参观长城。
words.en: Tourists are people who are visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.ex: The ovens in the kitchen are very old.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里的烤箱很旧了。
words.en: An oven is a piece of equipment which is used for cooking food, especially by baking or roasting it.

words.tr: v. 制作；使得；做；“make”的过去式和过去分词； adj. …制作的；
words.ex: She made a cake for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为弟弟做了一个蛋糕。
words.en: To produce something, often using a particular material or method.

words.tr: v. 发展；发育；“develop”的现在分词； adj. 发展中的；
words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: A developing country or area of the world is poorer and has less advanced industries, especially in Africa, Latin America, or Asia.

words.ex: Many countries have beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家有美丽的海滩。
words.en: A country is a nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

words.ex: He remained unaffected by the noise.
words.ex_cn: 他没有受到噪音的影响。
words.en: If someone or something is unaffected by an event or occurrence, they are not changed by it in any way.

words.tr: n. [建]水泥；[地质]胶结物，[胶粘]粘合剂（cement 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The workers mixed cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 工人们混合水泥来砌墙。
words.en: To cement something means to make it stronger or more solid. It can also refer to the act of binding materials together with cement.

words.ex: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收水。
words.en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: Forests are home to many animals.
words.ex_cn: 森林是许多动物的家园。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.ex_cn: 面包的价格太高了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: The roads are busy in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上的道路很繁忙。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.tr: n. 空地；空间；空白；“space”的复数；
words.ex: The children play in the open spaces.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在空地上玩耍。
words.en: Spaces refer to the areas that are empty or available for use, or the distances between things.

words.ex: Eating vegetables makes you healthier.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜让你更健康。
words.en: Comparative form of healthy; more healthy.

words.ex: A large crowd gathered at the square.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人聚集在广场上。
words.en: A crowd is a large group of people who have gathered together, for example, to watch or listen to something interesting, or to protest about something.

words.tr: adj. 感到（或显得）幸福的；幸福的( happy的比较级 )；
words.ex: She feels happier after talking to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和朋友聊完后感觉更幸福了。
words.en: Comparative form of happy. Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
words.en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

words.ex: He pays taxes every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: Taxes are amounts of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: The election will be held next month.
words.ex_cn: 选举将在下个月举行。
words.en: An election is a process in which people vote to choose a person or group of people to hold an official position.

words.tr: adj. 被污染的； v. “pollute”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The river is polluted by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: If something is polluted, it is made dirty or harmful, usually because of chemicals or waste.

words.ex: The car moved to the right lane to turn.
words.ex_cn: 汽车驶入右侧车道转弯。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. A lane is also one of the parts into which a wide road is divided, each of which is intended for vehicles moving in the same direction.

words.ex: Good relationships need trust and communication.
words.ex_cn: 良好的关系需要信任和沟通。
words.en: The way in which two or more people or things are connected.

words.ex: Children see many advertisements on TV.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在电视上看到很多广告。
words.en: Advertisements are notices, pictures, or films telling people about a product, service, or event.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他去商场买衣服。
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: There are 31 women in the meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 会议室里有31名女性。
words.en: Women are adult human females.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.ex: He hurt his body while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤到了身体。
words.en: The physical structure of a person or an animal, including the bones, flesh, and organs.

words.ex: He wears gloves to keep his hands warm.
words.ex_cn: 他戴手套来保暖双手。
words.en: Gloves are pieces of clothing which cover your hands and wrists and have individual sections for each finger. You wear gloves to keep your hands warm or dry or to protect them.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.ex: He wears a nylon jacket to stay dry.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件尼龙夹克来保持干燥。
words.en: Nylon is a strong, elastic synthetic fiber used especially in the manufacture of clothing, ropes, and brushes.

words.tr: n. 呼吸； v. 呼吸；“breathe”的现在分词；
words.ex: Deep breathing helps you relax.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于你放松。
words.en: The process of taking air into the lungs and expelling it; a sign of life.

words.tr: adj. 未受控制、约束或统治的；
words.ex: The fire spread in an uncontrolled way.
words.ex_cn: 火以一种不受控制的方式蔓延。
words.en: If something is uncontrolled, no-one is controlling it or checking that it is done properly, so it may continue or spread without being stopped.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.ex: The pilots flew the plane safely through the storm.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地将飞机飞过了风暴。
words.en: A pilot is a person who is trained to fly an aircraft or a ship.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr:
n. 睡眠；
v. 睡觉；
words.ex: He needs more sleep to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更多的睡眠来感觉好些。
words.en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind is unconscious.

words.tr: v. （使）漂浮；（使）浮动( float的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The leaf floated on the water.
words.ex_cn: 树叶漂浮在水面上。
words.en: If something floats or if you float it, it stays on the surface of a liquid and does not sink.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.tr: n. 工具；刀具；器具；“tool”的复数；
words.ex: He uses simple tools to fix the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的工具修理椅子。
words.en: Tools are objects such as hammers, screwdrivers, or saws that you use to help you do a particular type of work.

words.tr: n. 指令；说明；指示；“instruction”的复数；
words.ex: Follow the instructions on the box.
words.ex_cn: 按照盒子上的指令操作。
words.en: Instructions are detailed information about how to do something, especially how to use a piece of equipment or perform a task.

words.tr: n. 口音；[语]重音（accent 的复数）; v. 重读；强调（accent 的第三人称单数）
words.ex: People from different countries have different accents.
words.ex_cn: 来自不同国家的人有不同的口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.ex: He wrote down the numbers on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他把数字写在了纸上。
words.en: Numbers are symbols or words used to represent quantities or values in mathematics, counting, or identification.

words.ex: She loves to listen to old songs.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢听老歌。
words.en: A song is a short piece of music with words that are sung.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.tr: n. 情绪；情感；情感：“emotion”的复数；
words.ex: Children often show their emotions by crying or laughing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们常常通过哭泣或大笑来表现他们的情绪。
words.en: Feelings such as happiness, sadness, anger, or love, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞走了。
words.en: The wings of a bird or insect are the two parts of its body that it uses for flying.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.tr: n. 警示； v. 警告；“warn”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign gave a warning about the slippery road.
words.ex_cn: 标志提醒了道路湿滑的警示。
words.en: A warning is something which is said or written to tell people of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.tr:
n. 一半；
adj. 一半的；
adv. 一半地；
words.ex: He ate half of the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了苹果的一半。
words.en: One of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.tr: adj. 侧线的（位于体侧的感觉器官）
words.ex: The fish uses its lateral-line to sense water movement.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的侧线来感知水流的运动。
words.en: A lateral-line is a system of sense organs found in aquatic vertebrates, used to detect movement and vibration in the surrounding water.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: The car drove fast on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: The birds fly high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中高飞。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.tr: n. 洪水泛滥； v. 淹没；“flood”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused flooding in the city.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了城市洪水泛滥。
words.en: Flooding refers to the overflow of water onto land that is normally dry, often caused by heavy rainfall, melting snow, or the failure of dams or levees.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.tr: v. 幸存，活下来；幸免于难；幸存，活下来( survive的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只受了轻伤。
words.en: If someone survives in a dangerous situation such as an accident or an illness, they do not die.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.tr: v. 咀嚼；“chew” 现在分词；
words.ex: He is chewing gum quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在安静地咀嚼口香糖。
words.en: The act of biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.ex: The doctor gave me some medicines for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了些治感冒的药。
words.en: Medicines are substances that are used to treat or prevent diseases and illnesses.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: The pipes leak water in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 地下室的管道在漏水。
words.en: Pipes are long, hollow objects through which liquids or gases can flow, or a device for smoking tobacco, consisting of a narrow tube made from wood, clay, etc. with a small bowl at one end.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.ex: The factory has many machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂里有许多机器。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.ex: He loves playing sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: Sports are physical activities or games, often competitive and organized, that involve skill and physical exertion.

words.ex: He collects rainwater in a barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他用桶收集雨水。
words.en: Rainwater is water that has fallen as rain and is often collected and used for various purposes, such as watering plants.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.ex: He ate a coconut for snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一个椰子当零食。
words.en: A coconut is the large brown seed of a tropical tree, which has a hard shell containing white flesh that you can eat and a clear liquid that you can drink.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.tr: v. 按；压榨；“press”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He pressed the button to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他按了按钮来开门。
words.en: If you are pressed for time or money, you have very little of it.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.tr: adj. 干的；干燥的； v. 变干；“dry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She ate dried fruit for a snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃干果当零食。
words.en: If something is dried, it has had all the moisture removed from it, often to preserve it.

words.tr: n. 商人；经销商；“trader”的复数；
words.ex: The traders sell fruit at the market.
words.ex_cn: 商人们在市场卖水果。
words.en: People who buy and sell goods, especially in large quantities.

words.ex: The children are playing with balls in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩球。
words.en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as football, baseball, and basketball. A ball can also refer to a formal dance event.

words.tr: v. （使）疲劳( tire的第三人称单数 ); 对（做）某事感到厌倦
words.ex: Long hours of work tires him.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的工作让他感到疲劳。
words.en: If something tires you or if you tire, you feel that you have used a lot of energy and you want to rest or sleep.

words.ex: He lives in germany.
words.ex_cn: 他住在德国。
words.en: Germany is a country in Central Europe. It is bordered to the north by the North Sea, Denmark, and the Baltic Sea; to the east by Poland and the Czech Republic; to the south by Austria and Switzerland; and to the west by France, Luxembourg, Belgium, and the Netherlands.

words.tr: n. 驾驶； v. 驱使；驾驶；“drive”的现在分词； adj. 强有力的；推动的；
words.ex: Driving is his favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 驾驶是他最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of controlling and steering a vehicle.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 烹饪； adj. 烹调用的； v. 烹饪；“cook”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cooking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of preparing food by heating it.

words.tr: n. 包装；装箱；包装物； v. “package”的现在分词；
words.ex: The packaging of the gift was very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这份礼物的包装非常漂亮。
words.en: The materials in which goods are wrapped or packed, especially commercially.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.tr: n. 农事；耕作；养殖； v. 务农；“farm”的现在分词；
words.ex: Farming is hard work in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 农事在乡村是很辛苦的工作。
words.en: Farming is the activity of growing crops or keeping animals on a farm.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.tr: n. 钓鱼；捕鱼； v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；“fish”的现在分词；
words.ex: He likes fishing by the lake every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每周末去湖边钓鱼。
words.en: Fishing is the activity of trying to catch fish.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.ex: The child has two strong legs.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子有两条强壮的腿。
words.en: Legs are the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: The children saw butterflies in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在花园里看到了蝴蝶。
words.en: Butterflies are insects with large, often brightly coloured wings, which they use to fly.

words.ex: My feet hurt after walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 我走了一整天，脚很疼。
words.en: The plural of foot, which is the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks. Also, a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: We go to the beach during holidays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去海滩。
words.en: Holidays are days when people do not go to work or school, especially because of a religious or national celebration.

words.ex: The school has strict rules about uniforms.
words.ex_cn: 学校对校服有严格的规定。
words.en: Rules are statements that tell you what is or is not allowed in a particular situation or game, or instructions about how to behave or do something.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.tr: adj. 不公正的；不公平的；
words.ex: The teacher gave an unfair test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个不公正的考试。
words.en: If you describe a situation or action as unfair, you mean that it is not right or reasonable, especially because it does not treat people equally.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.ex: The bridge crosses the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥横跨河流。
words.en: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.tr: n. 样品陈列室；展销厅；
words.ex: The car showroom has many new models on display.
words.ex_cn: 汽车样品陈列室里有许多新款车型展出。
words.en: A showroom is a large room used for displaying goods, especially cars, furniture, or electrical appliances, for sale.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: She bought some flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一些花。
words.en: The seed-bearing part of a plant, consisting of reproductive organs that are typically surrounded by a brightly colored corolla and a green calyx.

words.tr: n. 土豆；马铃薯；“potato”的复数；
words.ex: I bought five potatoes at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上买了五个土豆。
words.en: Potatoes are starchy tubers that grow underground and are widely eaten as a staple food in many parts of the world.

words.ex: The building is made of limestone.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是由石灰岩建造的。
words.en: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the mineral calcite (calcium carbonate: CaCO3).

words.ex: The airline lost my luggage.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司弄丢了我的行李。
words.en: An airline is a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.ex: Many cities have busy streets and tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 许多城市都有繁忙的街道和高楼。
words.en: A city is a large town.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: He carries three trays of food to the table.
words.ex_cn: 他端着三个托盘的食物到餐桌。
words.en: A tray is a flat container with a raised edge, used for carrying things such as plates, cups, and food.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The company's sales increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售额增加了。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: He works in a medical center.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家医疗中心工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of medicine.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: She bought three eggs at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了三个蛋。
words.en: Eggs are oval objects that are produced by a female bird and which contain a baby bird. Chickens' eggs are often eaten as food.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.tr: n. 相互作用；相互影响；互动交流；
words.ex: The interaction between the two chemicals causes a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质之间的相互作用引起反应。
words.en: An interaction is a situation where two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: Children love to watch insects in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在花园里观察昆虫。
words.en: Insects are small creatures such as flies, ants, and bees that have six legs, a body divided into three parts, and often one or two pairs of wings.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.tr: v. 增加；增多；“increase”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 增加的；增强的；
words.ex: The company increased its sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年增加了销售额。
words.en: If something increases or you increase it, it becomes greater in number, level, or amount.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: I visited my grandparents twice last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年我去了祖父母家两次。
words.en: Two times; on two occasions.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: The bird flies over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟飞过树。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: The rain fell all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整夜。
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；家族；
adj. 家庭的；家族的；
words.ex: He belongs to the 587 family.
words.ex_cn: 他属于587家族。
words.en: A family is a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: The snake crawled slowly through the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蛇在草丛中缓慢地爬行。
words.en: A snake is a long, thin creature with no legs that slides along the ground.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.ex: The pond has many fishes.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里有很多鱼。
words.en: Fishes are aquatic vertebrates that are typically cold-blooded, covered with scales, and equipped with two sets of paired fins and several unpaired fins.

words.tr: n. 学习；学问； v. 学习；“learn”的现在分词；
words.ex: Learning takes time and practice.
words.ex_cn: 学习需要时间和练习。
words.en: The acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or being taught.

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.tr: n. 矿物；矿物质；“mineral”的复数；
words.ex: Rock contains many minerals like quartz and feldspar.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物，如石英和长石。
words.en: Minerals are solid substances that are formed naturally in the earth and are not of animal or vegetable origin.

words.tr: n. 数十年；几十年（decade的复数形式）
words.ex: He has lived in this city for decades.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座城市生活了几十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.tr: adj. 负有责任的；应作解释的
words.ex: He is accountable for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他要为自己的错误负责。
words.en: If you are accountable to someone for something that you do, you are responsible for it and must be prepared to justify your actions to that person.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.ex: Ancient philosophers asked big questions about life.
words.ex_cn: 古代哲学家思考关于生命的重大问题。
words.en: A philosopher is someone who studies or writes about philosophy, which is the study of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, values, reason, mind, and language.

words.ex: He always follows his morality in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他日常生活中总是遵循自己的道德。
words.en: Morality is the belief that some behaviour is right and acceptable and that other behaviour is wrong.

words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: n. 阿拉斯加（美国州名）
words.ex: He lives in Alaska with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在阿拉斯加。
words.en: Alaska is a state of the United States located in the northwest extremity of the North American continent.

words.tr: v. 跌倒；下降；砍伐；“fall”的过去式；
words.ex: He fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔了下来。
words.en: To cut down (a tree); to knock down (a person or animal); the skin of an animal with the hair or wool still on it; fierce or cruel.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的过去式；
words.ex: She picked a red rose from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵红玫瑰。
words.en: A rose is a flower, often with a pleasant smell, which grows on a bush with thorns on the stems.

words.tr: v. 繁荣；茂盛；“flourish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The town flourished after the new road was built.
words.ex_cn: 这条新路建成后，这个小镇繁荣了起来。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.tr: v. 杀死；“kill”的现在分词； n. 杀人； adj. 致命的；
words.ex: The lion was killing a deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只狮子正在杀死一只鹿。
words.en: The act of causing death, especially deliberately; or something that causes death or is very difficult to endure.

words.ex: Whales swim in the deep ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在深海中游动。
words.en: Whales are large marine mammals that live in the ocean. They are known for their size and are among the largest animals on Earth.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: He gave a situational answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个情境相关的回答。
words.en: Relating to or dependent on a set of circumstances or state of affairs.

words.ex: He is my friend.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的朋友。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.ex: His aspirations are to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的志向是成为一名医生。
words.en: Someone's aspirations are their desire to achieve things.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: The bridge has strong structures to support weight.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构来承受重量。
words.en: Structures refer to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex. They can also denote buildings or other constructions standing as a whole.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听无线电。
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.tr: n. 信号；“signal”的复数； v. 预示；
words.ex: The radio receives signals from satellites.
words.ex_cn: 收音机接收来自卫星的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.ex: The children played with stones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在院子里玩石子。
words.en: Hard solid non-metallic mineral matter of which rock is made, especially as a building material.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.tr: n. <英>饼干；<英>饼干( biscuit的名词复数 )；
words.ex: She ate a biscuit with tea in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她下午喝茶时吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A biscuit is a small, flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: The party was a celebration of her graduation.
words.ex_cn: 这个派对是她毕业的庆祝。
words.en: A celebration is a special enjoyable event that people organize because something pleasant has happened or because it is someone's birthday or anniversary.

words.tr:
n. 竖琴
v. 反复诉说；唠叨
words.ex: She plays the harp beautifully at concerts.
words.ex_cn: 她在音乐会上优美地演奏竖琴。
words.en: A harp is a large musical instrument consisting of a triangular frame with vertical strings which you pluck with your fingers. If someone harps on about something, they keep talking about it in a way that other people find annoying.

words.ex: The climbers grabbed the ropes to climb the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者抓住绳索来爬山。
words.en: Ropes are thick, strong strings made by twisting together several thinner strings. They are used for tying, pulling, or climbing.

words.ex: The houses near the park are small.
words.ex_cn: 公园附近的房子很小。
words.en: A building for human habitation, especially one that is lived in by a family or small group of people.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.tr: n. 倾听；收听； v. 听；“listen”的现在分词；
words.ex: Good listening helps you understand others.
words.ex_cn: 良好的倾听能帮助你理解他人。
words.en: The act of paying attention to and trying to hear something.

words.tr: n. 风险；“risk”的复数； v. 冒……风险；
words.ex: He knows the risks of climbing that mountain.
words.ex_cn: 他知道爬那座山的风险。
words.en: The possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: He has many problems with math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有很多问题。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.tr:
n. 银；银色；银器；
adj. 银的；银色的；
words.ex: Silver is a precious metal.
words.ex_cn: 银是一种贵金属。
words.en: Silver is a precious metal which is used to make jewellery, coins, and decorative objects.

words.ex: He found some coins in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他在口袋里发现了一些硬币。
words.en: Coins are small, flat, round pieces of metal used as money.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: The lions sleep under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在树下睡觉。
words.en: Lions are large, powerful carnivores of the family Felidae, often referred to as the 'king of the jungle'.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.ex: She brushed her hairs before going out.
words.ex_cn: 她出门前梳了梳头发。
words.en: Hairs are the fine thread-like strands that grow from the skin of humans and animals, especially on the head.

words.ex: The birds ate the worms in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在花园里吃了蠕虫。
words.en: Worms are small, long, thin creatures that have no bones and live in soil.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: He buys petrol every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五买汽油。
words.en: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used especially as a fuel in cars.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: He lives in Scotland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在苏格兰。
words.en: Scotland is a country that is part of the United Kingdom, known for its distinct culture, history, and landscapes.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.tr: v.经过重新培训的（动词retrain的过去分词）
words.ex: He was retrained to work as a technician.
words.ex_cn: 他被重新培训成为技术人员。
words.en: If someone is retrained, or if they retrain, they learn new skills, especially in order to get a new job.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: He uses simple strategies to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他使用简单的策略来解决数学问题。
words.en: A strategy is a plan or method chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achieving a goal or solving a problem.

words.ex: They are partners in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他们是小生意的合伙人。
words.en: A partner is a person or organization that you are working with in a business or on a project.

words.ex: Many organizations help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 许多组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: The shoppers bought apples and bread at the market.
words.ex_cn: 顾客们在市场买了苹果和面包。
words.en: People who are shopping or intending to shop.

words.tr: n. 细节；“detail”的复数； v. 详细说明；
words.ex: Can you give me the details of the meeting?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我会议的细节吗？
words.en: The word 'details' refers to the individual facts or elements that make up a larger whole. It is often used to describe the specific aspects or components of a subject that are important for understanding it fully.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: She carries her books in bags.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在包里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.tr: n. 清洁；打扫； v. 打扫；“clean”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cleaning of the room took an hour.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间花了一个小时。
words.en: The act of making something clean, especially the inside of a house or building.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: n. 广告活动；广告业； v. 做广告；“advertise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: The activity of producing advertisements for commercial products or services.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: He waits for days to get a reply.
words.ex_cn: 他等了好几天才得到回复。
words.en: Days refer to the time between sunrise and sunset, or a period of 24 hours.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: The frogs jump near the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙在池塘边跳跃。
words.en: Frogs are small, tailless amphibians with a short body, protruding eyes, and the ability to leap.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: The soil has too much moisture.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中有太多湿气。
words.en: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in a substance, that make it feel wet.

words.tr: v. 打字；定型；“type”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is typing a letter on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他正在电脑上打一封信。
words.en: The act of writing something using a typewriter or computer keyboard.

words.tr: n. （议会、法院等的）书记员；<美>店员；<英>办事员；<美>店员( clerk的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The clerks wrote down all the court proceedings.
words.ex_cn: 书记员记录了所有的法庭程序。
words.en: Clerks are people who work in offices or shops, performing tasks such as keeping records or serving customers.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.tr: n. 安全；保障；防护措施；
words.ex: The school improved security to protect students.
words.ex_cn: 学校加强了安全措施以保护学生。
words.en: Security refers to the state of being free from danger or threat, or measures taken to ensure safety.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: Dogs and cats are mammals.
words.ex_cn: 狗和猫是哺乳动物。
words.en: Mammals are warm-blooded vertebrates that are characterized by the presence of hair or fur and the ability to produce milk to feed their young.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: The edges of the paper are torn.
words.ex_cn: 纸的边缘撕破了。
words.en: The outer or furthest point of something.

words.ex: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。
words.en: The hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its skeleton.

words.ex: I look at old photos to remember my childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 我看着老照片来回忆我的童年记忆。
words.en: Memories are things that you remember about the past.

words.ex: Sleeping is important for health.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠对健康很重要。
words.en: The state of being asleep or the process of resting with your eyes closed and your mind and body not active.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.tr: n. 升温； v. （使）变暖；“warm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The warming of the planet is causing ice to melt.
words.ex_cn: 地球的升温正在导致冰层融化。
words.en: The process of becoming warmer; a rise in temperature.

words.ex: He eats nuts every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃坚果当早餐。
words.en: If you say that someone is nuts, you mean that they are crazy. Nuts are hard-shelled fruits of some trees.

words.ex: The sign has arrows pointing to the exit.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志上有指向出口的箭头。
words.en: Arrows are long, thin weapons that are shot from a bow. They have a sharp point at one end and usually feathers at the other end to help them fly straight.

words.ex: The children walk to school from small villages.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从各个小村庄步行去上学。
words.en: Small communities in rural areas, typically smaller than a town.

words.ex: Their marriage lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的婚姻持续了二十年。
words.en: The legally or formally recognized union of two people as partners in a personal relationship.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.tr: n. 检查员( inspector的名词复数 ); （英国公共汽车或火车上的）查票员; （警察）巡官
words.ex: The inspectors checked the building for safety.
words.ex_cn: 检查员检查了建筑物的安全状况。
words.en: An inspector is a person whose job is to inspect something, especially in order to check that it meets legal or official standards.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.tr: n. 处理；加工； v. 处理；加工；“process”的现在分词；
words.ex: The processing of data takes a long time.
words.ex_cn: 数据的处理需要很长时间。
words.en: The act of treating or preparing something by a special method.

words.tr: n. 标签；“label”的复数； v. 贴标签；
words.ex: The bottles have clear labels.
words.ex_cn: 这些瓶子上有清晰的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, plastic, or other material which is attached to an object and gives information about it.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.tr: n. 眼镜；玻璃杯；“glass”的复数；
words.ex: He wears glasses to see the board clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴眼镜以便清楚地看到黑板。
words.en: Glasses are objects worn in front of the eyes to help people see better. They consist of a pair of lenses set in a frame that rests on the nose and ears.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: The farmer planted corn in rich soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民在肥沃的土壤里种了玉米。
words.en: Soil is the substance on the surface of the earth in which plants grow, consisting of rock and mineral particles mixed with decayed organic matter.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.ex: Follow the guidelines to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 遵循指南以通过考试。
words.en: Guidelines are general rules, principles, or pieces of advice that help you to do something or to decide what to do in a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 显微镜( microscope的名词复数 )
words.ex: The students look at cells through microscopes.
words.ex_cn: 学生们通过显微镜观察细胞。
words.en: An optical instrument used for viewing very small objects, such as mineral samples or animal or plant cells, typically magnified several hundred times.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: Farmers use fertilizers to help crops grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用肥料来帮助庄稼生长。
words.en: Substances added to soil to improve its fertility and promote plant growth.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed drugs for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.tr: n. 变老；老化； v. “age”的现在分词；
words.ex: Aging is a natural part of life.
words.ex_cn: 变老是生命的一部分。
words.en: The process of becoming older or more mature.

words.tr:
v. 玩；扮演；演奏；播放；
n. 戏剧；比赛；
words.ex: The children play in the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园里玩。
words.en: When children, animals, or perhaps adults play, they spend time doing enjoyable things, such as using toys and taking part in games. When you play a sport, game, or match, you take part in it. Play is also a noun referring to a dramatic work or performance.

words.tr:
n. 方面；尊重；尊敬；
v. 遵从；尊重；尊敬；
words.ex: In this respect, the plan is good.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方面，这个计划很好。
words.en: If you respect someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: The dams hold back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 这些大坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.ex: He works on an agricultural farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个农场工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
